text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky got injured during training, so 
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Jeez, you're exaggerating so much.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this isn't a big deal at 
all. Let's just patch it up real quick.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're that worried, we can just 
call it a day for training, though?
choice_data_list: You need to rest up for a while!
If you feel up to it, want to keep going?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh... being told to stay still is kinda 
annoying too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trying to tie down someone as free as a 
cloud like Sei-chan to one place is asking 
for the impossible~.
choice_data_list: Come on, make it work somehow

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should I do~...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I'll behave, on the condition 
that you take care of Sei-chan instead.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"In such a wonderfully accommodating 
environment, I shall freely dedicate 
myself to making my comeback~♪"

Under the condition that various selfish 
demands were met, Seiun Sky finally agreed 
to undergo treatment.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does that mean you're not worried 
about Sei-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I did say it wasn't an injury serious 
enough to require absolute bed rest, yes."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if it gets worse from training, 
it'll be troublesome...”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it best to trust Sei-chan here and 
just let her do her thing?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Well, I hate being forced to stay still 
anyway, and there's no way I'd pass up a 
golden chance to slack off~

text_block_list.name: Late Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, I'm late late late for training~! 
Out of the waaay, pleaseー!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Gyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ouch! Ngh, that might have made my 
injury worse...!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it best to trust Sei-chan here and 
just let her do her thing?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I managed to talk Trainer into it, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I know my own body better than 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just spending my time carefree like always 
is the fastest way to make a comeback, 
y'know~

Thanks to taking her treatment at her own 
pace, her injury healed quickly, allowing 
Seiun Sky to resume her training in no 
time.
